title: core: concurrent group-log appends lose one entry from tip set
description:
## Problem
group_log/append.rs: the has_entry check and set_tips call are not atomic. Two concurrent IHAVE sessions that both ingest different articles pointing to the same parent tip will both pass the has_entry and parent-existence checks, both call insert_entry (succeeds for different IDs), but then both call set_tips({my_id}) sequentially — the second wins and the first entry ID is permanently dropped from the tip set. The orphaned entry is in storage but unreachable during CRDT reconciliation.

## Acceptance criteria
- set_tips must be replaced with an atomic compare-and-swap (set_tips only if tips == expected), or a write lock must be held from has_entry through set_tips
- A concurrent-append integration test must assert that both entries appear in list_tips after concurrent appends from the same parent
